priorityList: Maintain Virulent Plague using Outbreak if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining.
Cast Army of the Dead when available (ensure 30 Runic Power if Summon Gargoyle is talented).
Cast Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead is active or if its cooldown is longer than 30 seconds.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and combat Racials when Dark Transformation or Army of the Dead is active.
Cast Putrefy if you are at maximum charges or if Dark Transformation's cooldown is greater than 15 seconds.
Cast Death Coil if you have a Sudden Doom proc or if you have fewer than 2 Runes available (4 Runes if Forbidden Knowledge is active).
Cast Festering Strike if the Festering Scythe buff or debuff is about to expire (if talented).
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff to prepare for a Horseman summon.
Cast Scourge Strike if you have 1 or more stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff to summon a Horseman.
Cast Death Coil to dump excess Runic Power and avoid capping.
